compiled_state.title: As a preplanning orchestrator, I want Phase E to re-dispatch dso:story-decomposer with remediation_context when red-team/blue-team findings are non-empty
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Wire /dso:preplanning Phase E so that when dso:red-team-reviewer or dso:blue-team-filter return non-empty findings, the orchestrator builds a remediation_context payload (absolute paths to reviewer artifacts, target_story_ids extracted from findings), dispatches dso:story-decomposer with subagent_type matching the agent and the literal `model: "opus"` field on the dispatch payload, and consumes only the delta output.

**Why**: SC1 caller-side — closes the loop between findings and the upgraded story-decomposer producer contract. Without this, the producer's delta-mode contract is unused and operators still see inline-transcribed remediation.

**Scope**:
- IN: /dso:preplanning Phase E edits to construct remediation_context and dispatch the producer
- IN: Synthetic-findings fixture from SC1's verification clause asserting dispatch shape, by-reference payload, mode declaration, evidence quotes, and absence of unlisted stories
- IN: Null-case guard (empty findings → no re-dispatch)
- OUT: Producer agent definition (delivered by SC1 producer-contract story — depended on)
- OUT: Shared loop protocol details (delivered by SC4 shared-protocol story — depended on)

## Done Definitions

- When red-team or blue-team return non-empty findings in Phase E, the orchestrator's next Task dispatch targets dso:story-decomposer with the literal `model: "opus"` field set on the dispatch payload (not just the agent name). The synthetic-findings fixture asserts the model field on the payload, catching accidental sonnet downgrade
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The remediation_context payload sent in Phase E contains absolute file paths to reviewer artifacts and target_story_ids, not embedded finding bodies
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- Synthetic-findings fixture passes: assertions (a) subagent_type AND model: "opus" field, (b) by-reference payload shape, (c) DELTA OUTPUT mode declaration plus evidence quotes from each artifact, (d) absence of unlisted stories
  ← Satisfies: sc-1
- When red-team and blue-team both return empty findings, Phase E does NOT re-dispatch dso:story-decomposer (null-case guard)
  ← Satisfies: sc-1

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Artifact paths must be canonicalized to absolute form before being passed to the sub-agent; the worktree base directory differs between orchestrator and sub-agent contexts.
- [Observability] The Phase E dispatch should record a single ticket comment referencing the reviewer-artifact path (alignment with the SC5 single-comment policy).

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
